summary: Cover owned leader exit status while a descendant keeps its process group running.

replay.detail: Adds a deterministic Linux FIFO/pidfd regression for the existing owned-child reaping fix. It checks running-descendant status, child reaping and the persisted terminal record. Test-only addition; no further runtime or stored-format change.
